samples.xml_description:
<module id="square_wave">
    <description>Generates a square wave based on the input frequency.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal for the module.</input>
        <input id="freq" width_description="[7:0]">Frequency control for the square wave.</input>
        <output id="wave_out">Square wave output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Counts up to freq and then resets to 0, toggling wave_out at each count.</implementation>
</module>
